honesty_decisions: Identity, creative and delivery are REAL (traffic log + the one priced ledger the money board reads). Only the commitment (flight window, budget, rating goal) is the seed's, and every row carries is_demo true plus the rule that made it.
A flight day with no per-spot source is an unknown row with blank figure cells, never a zero. Every counted figure is published as a floor with the reason.
Progress is None when there is no source at all: zero counted out of no source is not zero delivered. This defect was found by a test and fixed in campaigns_delivery._progress.
A campaign whose every spot was removed by a frequency rule has no observed spend, so its budget is blank rather than 0.
Rating points are the planned break rating on the all-viewers base. A goal named against any other audience reports progress unavailable with the reason, never against a substituted base.
The rating-goal audience vocabulary is the market list in docs/campaign-rate-card-research.md section 11. The owner's 'women 35 plus' example is not in that research, so women 25-54 is used instead.
